title: Incredible.

title: Great tour

title: Great Tour
text: We had a fantastic tour, lots of good food, and so much Vermuth! 10/10 would book again! Small group guide was wonderful, food was tasty and we got lots of history.
author: V217DNaaronj

title: Go Brais!
text: Brais was amazing. He’s knowledgeable, funny, sincere, and charming. He’s also very good to the kitchen staff. We had a delightful time with him, and the tapas were yummy too. This is a lovely way to explore local restaurants.
author: brendatB6367AE

title: Great
text: The guide for our smell group was Brais. He took us to a variety of places to try traditional and unique tapas and drink choices. Really enjoyed the tour.
author: juliedS9924VI

title: Awesome Tapas Tour!
text: Brais was an excellent guide! We tried lots of different tapas and drinks. What was surprising was that sometimes the foods I never would have ordered were the ones I liked the best! It was a fun and memorable experience and a great way to explore Barcelona through food.
author: 717natalief

title: Excellent experience !
text: Great choices for places and a great guide - Brais was very knowledgeable and great stories!
author: stevenmV9835PP

title: Amazing!
text: Brais was such a great tour guide! We had some delicious food and learned a lot! Really enjoyed the variety of food, drinks and restaurants.
author: Meeghan H

title: Brais is the BEST
text: Brais was wonderful and so passionate about the history behind Spanish culture, food, and drinks. Our group loved having him lead us and we were surprised when it ended because time flew so quickly laughing drinking and eating together. Thanks Brais!
